EP-SRC-000001.official_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)

EP-SRC-000002.official_title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)

claims.claim: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act is Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024, CELEX 32024R1689.

claims.display_label: AI Act · Art. 113 · entry into force
claims.claim: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 entered into force on 1 August 2024.

claims.display_label: AI Act · Art. 113(3)(a) · Chapters I & II
claims.claim: Chapters I and II of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 apply from 2 February 2025.

sources.provision_locator: Article 1, point (40)(a) (replaces Article 113 third paragraph point (a) of 2024/1689)

claims.display_label: AI Act · Art. 113(3)(b) · GPAI + governance tranche
claims.claim: Under Article 113, third paragraph, point (b) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII, Chapter XII and Article 78 apply from 2 August 2025, with the exception of Article 101.
The general date of application of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 is 2 August 2026 (Article 113, second paragraph); this date was retained after amendment by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

claims.display_label: AI Act · Art. 113(3)(a) · new Article 5 prohibitions
claims.claim: The prohibited practices added to Article 5 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 — Article 5(1)(ba), (bb) and Article 5(1a), (1b) — apply from 2 December 2026.

sources.provision_locator: Article 1, point (40)(a) (replaces Article 113 third paragraph point (a) of 2024/1689)

claims.display_label: AI Act · Art. 113(3)(c)(i) · high-risk Annex III
claims.claim: Obligations for high-risk AI systems classified pursuant to Article 6(2) and Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 apply from 2 December 2027, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

sources.provision_locator: Article 1, point (40)(b) (replaces Article 113 third paragraph point (c) of 2024/1689) → point (c)(i)
Article 113, third paragraph, point (c)(i); Article 6(2); Annex III

claims.display_label: AI Act · Art. 113(3)(c)(ii) · high-risk Annex I
claims.claim: Obligations for high-risk AI systems classified pursuant to Article 6(1) and Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 apply from 2 August 2028, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

sources.provision_locator: Article 1, point (40)(b) (replaces Article 113 third paragraph point (c) of 2024/1689) → point (c)(ii)
Article 113, third paragraph, point (c)(ii); Article 6(1); Annex I

claims.display_label: Digital Omnibus on AI · instrument identity
claims.claim: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI), CELEX 32026R1744, amends Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (and Regulations (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230); the amendments to the AI Act are made by its Article 1.
Articles 102 to 110 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 apply from 27 July 2026, under Article 113 third paragraph point (d) added by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

sources.provision_locator: Article 1, point (40)(c) (adds Article 113 third paragraph point (d) to 2024/1689)

claims.display_label: Digital Omnibus on AI · entry into force
claims.claim: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 was published in the Official Journal on 24 July 2026 and entered into force on 27 July 2026 (the third day following publication), per its Article 4.
